title: Service Charges Carried into the Arrears Settlement Figure, Crop Input Purchasing Accounts
content:
**1.** An account of the Crop Input Purchasing Accounts that has been charged for its arrears more than once in the season carries those charges into the figure that settles it, and how much of them is carried in follows how many stand over the 10 statement months before the handling date.

**2.** Where three or more service charges stand on the account over those months, the share carried in is the whole of them — 100 percent.

**3.** Where one or two service charges stand on the account over those months, the share carried in is half of them — 50 percent.

**4.** In every other case no share of the service charges standing on the account is carried into the settlement figure.

**5.** The share is a share of the service charges standing on the account, which is the whole of what the account carries in charges rather than only those posted inside the window; the count inside the window decides which of the shares in 2 and 3 is reached.

**6.** On a hypothetical account carrying 900.00 USD of service charges in all, with two of them posted inside the 10 statement months, the share carried in is half, and 450.00 USD is carried into the settlement figure. A third charge posted inside that window would carry the whole 900.00 USD in. With no charge posted inside the window, nothing is carried in although charges stand on the account.
